events.title: THE OPEN FONDA

events.title: Strung Out (USA)
events.description: US punk-metal mainstays Strung Out return to Australia this September to celebrate 30 years of their landmark album Suburban Teenage Wasteland Blues with a national run of headline shows. Originally released in 1996, Suburban Teenage Wasteland Blues crammed 13 songs into 32 breakneck minutes and became a defining record for a generation of punk fans. From the opening blast of “Firecracker” through to “Wrong Side of the Tracks”, the album’s mix of hook-heavy melodies and high-speed riffs still hits just as hard today. Across ten albums and countless tours, Strung Out have built a reputation as one of the most explosive live bands in punk rock – loud, tight and direct, with no throwbacks for the sake of it and no wasted moments.   This September, Australian fans will hear Suburban Teenage Wasteland Blues celebrated throughout the set, alongside favourites from across the band’s catalogue.

events.title: Roaring Lion (Bob Marley Tribute)
events.description: Get ready for a proper Bob Marley celebration with Roaring Lion, Queensland’s powerhouse 8-piece tribute band bringing the sounds of "The Legend" to life. Expect all the classics - Exodus, Could You Be Loved, Buffalo Soldier, Three Little Birds, One Love - the kind of set that gets everyone singing, moving, and locked in from the first song. Grab your crew and vibe it out. Whether you’re a longtime Marley fan or just want a solid night with good music and good energy, this one hits right. Roaring Lion is Australia’s premiere Bob Marley tribute band. On stage, its eight band members present a colourful explosion of the best reggae of our times - the beautiful and enduring music of Bob Marley. Formed in 2019, Roaring Lion is based in Queensland and has been performing regularly throughout Queensland. Roaring Lion have also performed in New South Wales and Melbourne, Victoria. Everywhere they play, their audiences sing and dance, in happy celebration of the man and his message. The musicians in Roaring Lion work hard to represent Bob Marley’s music with respect and authenticity. The music is classic roots reggae with drum ‘n’ bass, bubble, skank, lead and rhythm guitars. Backing vocalists sing harmonies on every song, while keys play the familiar sounds of clavinet, Moog, and Hammond organ, plus horns and strings. In 2024, Roaring Lion had the honour to open the Queensland premiere for the ‘Bob Marley: One Love’ movie by Paramount Pictures. The band consistently presents a tight show of the most popular songs, as well as other well-known and cherished melodies. Roaring Lion continues to grow its repertoire of over sixty songs to keep shows fresh and deepen engagement with its loyal followers. Roaring Lion delivers a show for all to remember, and is consistently invited back to perform at venues.

events.title: Madonna Night: A Celebration Of The Queen Of Pop
events.description: Madonna  Night is a wall-to-wall celebration of the undisputed Queen of Pop, coming to Miami Marketta on Friday October 2nd. Expect everything from Like a Prayer, Vogue  and Into the Groove  to Hung Up, Music, Ray of Light  and plenty more. events.title: GILSONS Australia Tour 2026
events.description: Fibra Entertainment presents: Gilsons Australia Tour 2026 Formed in 2018, Gilsons isn’t your average family band. The trio, representing two generations of one of Brazil's most legendary families, balance original music with an homage to the music of Gilberto Gil, their father (José) and grandfather (Francisco, João) . Known far and wide as one of the progenitors of the countercultural and widely popular tropicália movement, Gilberto remains one of the biggest names in Música Popular Brasileira. Though a seemingly impossible task, Gilsons builds upon the Gil family musical lineage with their blend of pop rock, samba, reggae, and Bahian (northeastern Brazil) rhythms.  The band's debut album, Pra Gente Acordar, earned a Latin Grammy nomination for Best Contemporary Pop Album in Portuguese Language, and they’ve taken to the stages of many of Brazil’s major festivals – including Lollapalooza Brazil, and, alongside another national musical icon, Jorge Aragão, for over 100,000 people, at the Rock in Rio festival.
